runs.t: “It has grown late,” said Jack. “Say nothing more,” Tom replied. The way was longer than it had looked on the map. “You should have come sooner,” said Emma. “I do not know,” Robert replied.

The next day Jack set off with the rope under one arm, without saying goodbye. The lamplight trembled as someone opened the door. “Wait until tomorrow,” said Alice. “That will not be enough,” Robert replied.

The road ran in a wide arc around the hill. Jack put the coat down by the lighthouse and waited. On the table lay bread, a knife and a note nobody wanted to touch. “It was never my decision,” said Robert, and looked at Tom.
